title: MZ I need help with 'Show Choices' script...

posts.author: ap9lsyn
Solar_Flare
posts.body:
I think I may be missing something… what exactly is there in that code that can't already be done with the Show Choices event command? I don't see see anything there that sets the initially-selected choice.
Another thing I might be missing is, why don't you use the built-in select item command? It sounds like you want to select an item, which is what that does, but if that doesn't work for you, maybe I'm misunderstanding something?
Back to the question: I think doing this by script would be very difficult when you don't know JavaScript. I'd recommend instead using the normal Show Choices event command finding some plugins – for hiding certain choices, I recommend Aloe_ConditionalChoices, but there's also HIME_HiddenChoiceConditions. I'm not sure where to find a plugin that remembers the last selected choice, but I think it could be thrown together if it doesn't exist already. The main difficulty there would be that each choice command probably wants to have a different last selected choice. But at least with this method you can still edit the choices and branches using the regular event editing UI.
If you really,
really
want to do this by script, you can certainly make a conditional branch on the 101 variable. You could also put the code you need to run inside the choice callback function. It really depends on what you're trying to do, I think.
